The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 26 cm, measured across the outer rim. In the image it spans roughly 660 px, so about 25 px per cm.

The lasagna piece is about 290 px wide and 230 px tall, which is roughly 11.5 cm by 9 cm. Its height is probably 3-4 cm. That gives a volume of about 11 × 8 × 3.5 ≈ 300 cm³. At a density of about 0.9 g/cm³ this comes to roughly 250 g. Lasagna with sauce runs about 1.5 kcal/g, so I estimate about 350 kcal. Since the piece looks somewhat thin, I'll take about 220 g and about 330 kcal.

The two chicken pieces are small, roughly 5 cm each. They look like pieces of baked chicken thigh or breast with the skin on, and together they weigh about 90 g. At about 1.8 kcal/g that is roughly 160 kcal.

Adding the two gives about 310 g and about 490 kcal.
